g.text: PLINDER-22 · one connected line per molecule · the same molecule keeps its color in both panels

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #626c78

g.text: Three molecules are worst for at least one method (colored); the other 19 are grey. New Qwen run is bold.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #626c78

g.text: Outlined markers identify each method’s largest distance; numbers give that molecule’s value in Å.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #626c78

g.text: Full supplied ensembles; no common PoseBusters filter. † Torsion raw starts from an experimental conformation.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #626c78

g.text: Methods are categorical, ordered by mean MAT-R. Connecting lines track identity, not a continuous trend.
